author: Yoiyami
description: First Light Particles is a calm, atmospheric piano piece designed for story-driven games, exploration scenes, dream sequences, and emotional cutscenes. It features: •soft shimmering piano •subtle low-frequency pulses •transparent blue-tone harmony •slow emotional movement •no groove, no percussion •gentle ambient pads drifting like early morning light The mood is peaceful, introspective, and slightly cosmic, suitable for: •VN / visual novels •indie RPGs •space exploration •atmospheric platformers •menu / title screen •meditation / quiet areas •“first morning light”, “awakening”, “memories resurfacing” scenes This track is CC0 (public domain) — free to use in any project, no attribution required (though appreciated).
